options.label: Year first, month in words
options.rule: Write dates with the year first, the month in words, and the day in numerals with a closing period. Examples: 2025. április 23.; 1990. november 1..

options.label: YYYY. MM. DD.
options.rule: Write dates in numeric form as YYYY. MM. DD., including periods after the year, month, and day. Examples: 2025. 04. 23.; 1990. 11. 01..

options.label: YYYY-MM-DD
options.rule: Write dates in numeric form as YYYY-MM-DD. Examples: 2025-04-23; 1990-11-01.

options.label: DD.MM.YYYY
options.rule: Write dates in numeric form as DD.MM.YYYY. Examples: 23.04.2025; 01.11.1990.

options.label: Write years in full
options.rule: Write years in full. Examples: 1989; 2025.

options.label: Abbreviate years with an apostrophe
options.rule: When an abbreviated year is acceptable, write only the last two digits and precede them with an apostrophe. Examples: '89; '25.

options.label: 24-hour clock with colon
options.rule: Use the 24-hour clock with a colon as separator. Examples: 08:30; 17:00; 22:15.

options.label: 24-hour clock with period
options.rule: Use the 24-hour clock with a period as separator. Examples: 8.30; 17.00; 22.15.

options.label: Write times in words
options.rule: When the context is informal or idiomatic, write times in words using standard Hungarian expressions. Examples: fél kilenc; negyed három; háromnegyed hat.

options.label: Use the symbol after the amount, with a space
options.rule: Write currency amounts with the symbol or abbreviated unit after the amount, separated by a space. Examples: 5 Ft; 10 €.

options.label: Use the ISO code before the amount
options.rule: Write currency amounts with the ISO currency code before the amount, separated by a space. Examples: HUF 5000; EUR 10.

options.label: Write the currency name after the amount
options.rule: Write the amount first and the currency name after it. Examples: 5000 forint; 10 euró.

options.label: Use the symbol before the amount, without a space
options.rule: Write currency amounts with the currency symbol before the amount, without a space. Examples: €10; $5.

options.label: Use a decimal comma and spaces for thousands
options.rule: Use a comma as the decimal separator and spaces as thousands separators. Examples: 5,90; 1 250; 15 870,33.

options.label: Use a decimal comma and periods for thousands
options.rule: Use a comma as the decimal separator and periods as thousands separators. Examples: 5,90; 1.250; 15.870,33.

options.label: Use a decimal period and commas for thousands
options.rule: Use a period as the decimal separator and commas as thousands separators. Examples: 5.90; 1,250; 15,870.33.

options.label: Use % without a space
options.rule: Write percentages with the percent sign directly after the number, without a space. Example: 99%.

options.label: Use % with a space
options.rule: Write percentages with a space between the number and the percent sign. Example: 99 %.

options.label: Write százalék in words
options.rule: Write percentages with the word “százalék”. Examples: 99 százalék; tíz százalék.

options.label: Abbreviate with numerals, spell out without
options.rule: Abbreviate units when used with numerals, but spell them out when no numeral is used. Examples: 4 kg; néhány kilogramm.

options.label: Always abbreviate
options.rule: Always abbreviate units, whether or not a numeral is used. Examples: 4 kg; néhány kg.

options.label: Always spell out
options.rule: Always spell out units, whether or not a numeral is used. Examples: 4 kilogramm; néhány kilogramm.

options.label: Use a space between numeral and unit
options.rule: Use a space between a numeral and the unit. Example: 4 kg.

options.label: Do not use a space between numeral and unit
options.rule: Do not use a space between a numeral and the unit. Example: 4kg.

options.label: Use the unit symbol with a space
options.rule: Write temperatures with the unit symbol after the number and a space in between. Examples: 32 °C; 98 °F; 273 K.

options.label: Use the unit symbol without a space
options.rule: Write temperatures with the unit symbol directly after the number, without a space. Examples: 32°C; 98°F; 273K.

options.label: Write the unit in words
options.rule: Write temperatures with the unit in words. Examples: 32 Celsius-fok; 98 Fahrenheit-fok.

options.label: Use low-high Hungarian quotation marks
options.rule: Use Hungarian low-high quotation marks for quotations. Example: „Ez jó hír” – mondta.

options.label: Use double curly quotation marks
options.rule: Use double curly quotation marks for quotations. Example: “Ez jó hír” – mondta.

options.label: Use double straight quotation marks
options.rule: Use double straight quotation marks for quotations. Example: "Ez jó hír" – mondta.

options.label: Use low-high quotation marks first and guillemets for nested quotes
options.rule: Use Hungarian low-high quotation marks for primary quotations and guillemets for nested quotations. Example: „Azt mondta: »Holnap jövök.«”

options.label: Use double quotation marks first and single quotation marks for nested quotes
options.rule: Use double quotation marks for primary quotations and single quotation marks for nested quotations. Example: “Azt mondta: ‘Holnap jövök.’”

options.label: Use an en dash for ranges
options.rule: Use an en dash for ranges. Examples: hétfő–péntek; 2001–2003.

options.label: Use a hyphen for ranges
options.rule: Use a hyphen for ranges. Examples: hétfő-péntek; 2001-2003.

options.label: Use -tól ... -ig constructions
options.rule: Write ranges using the Hungarian -tól ... -ig construction. Examples: hétfőtől péntekig; 2001-től 2003-ig.

options.label: Use the ellipsis character
options.rule: Use the single ellipsis character. Example: Még várunk….

options.label: Use three periods
options.rule: Use three periods for an ellipsis. Example: Még várunk....

options.label: Keep the original format
options.rule: Keep telephone numbers in the original or official format.

options.label: Group digits with spaces
options.rule: Group telephone numbers into readable blocks using spaces. Example: +36 30 123 4567.

options.label: Do not use spaces
options.rule: Write telephone numbers without spaces. Example: +36301234567.

options.label: Use abbreviations sparingly
examples: például a pl. helyett, ha a szövegformátum engedi
options.rule: Use abbreviations sparingly and prefer fully written words where clarity benefits. Example: például a pl. helyett, ha a szövegformátum engedi.

options.label: Use common abbreviations
options.rule: Use common abbreviations where they are standard and unambiguous. Examples: pl.; ill.; kb..

rules.title: Capitalization
rules.rule: Avoid writing entire words or sentences in capitals, except for acronyms, initialisms, and official names.

options.label: Prefer active voice
options.rule: Prefer active voice and use passive constructions only when the actor is unknown, irrelevant, or intentionally omitted.

options.label: Allow passive constructions where they improve focus
options.rule: Use passive constructions where they improve focus on the action or result rather than the actor.

options.label: Prefer Hungarian equivalents
options.rule: Prefer established Hungarian equivalents over English loanwords where a natural Hungarian alternative exists. Examples: határidő a deadline helyett; visszajelzés a feedback helyett.

options.label: Allow established loanwords
options.rule: Use established loanwords where they are common and clear in Hungarian usage. Examples: marketing; online; projekt.

options.label: Spell out low numbers
options.rule: Spell out low numbers in running text where this improves readability. Examples: két résztvevő; nyolc nap.

options.label: Prefer numerals
options.rule: Prefer numerals for most numbers, including low numbers, for consistency and scannability. Examples: 2 résztvevő; 8 nap.

options.label: Use formal address
options.rule: Address the reader formally using magázás or önözés.

options.label: Use informal address
options.rule: Address the reader informally using tegezés.

options.label: Prefer neutral words and role names
options.rule: Prefer gender-neutral words and role names where possible. Examples: munkatárs; ügyfél; hallgató.

options.label: Use explicitly paired feminine and masculine forms
options.rule: Use explicitly paired feminine and masculine forms where naming both is preferred. Examples: tanárnők és tanárok; munkatársnők és munkatársak.

options.label: Use a direct and concise tone
options.rule: Use a direct, concise, and practical tone.

options.label: Use a warm and accessible tone
options.rule: Use a warm, friendly, and accessible tone.

options.label: Use a formal and neutral tone
options.rule: Use a formal, neutral, and precise tone.

rules.title: Anglicisms
rules.rule: Avoid unnecessary anglicisms when a natural and widely understood Hungarian equivalent exists.
